name: Nihon Dengi Co., Ltd.
summary: Nihon Dengi Co., Ltd. engages in the design, installation, fine-tuning, and maintenance of automatic control systems in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Air Conditioning Instrumentation-Related Business; and Industrial-System Related Business. The Air Conditioning and Instrumentation Related Business segment designs. Constructs, maintains, and inspects air conditioning control systems for non-residential buildings, such as office buildings, factories, hospitals, research institutes, schools, and commercial facilities.
